correctness.rationale: The exact equation and support parametrization were reconstructed. A standalone SymPy verifier proves that the projective parametrization lands on the octic and is generically one-to-one, solves the affine Jacobian system, verifies six ordinary nodes by a nonzero Hessian determinant on a symmetry representative, verifies Puiseux valuation pairs (3,4) at each real cusp and (2,7) at each point at infinity, and checks that the delta sum 21 equals the arithmetic genus. The proof therefore covers all singularities and does not infer an infinite statement from a finite sample.

value.rationale: The curve is a canonical minimal-degree noncircular algebraic curve of constant width. The exact singularity basket is a natural intrinsic invariant: it explains how a convex real octic can nevertheless have rational normalization and decomposes the full arithmetic genus into three real curvature-degeneracy cusps, six hidden complex nodes, and two cusps at infinity. This is structural information about a named extremal example, not an arbitrary slice or a routine recomputation.
